title: Office Small Talk
locationRef: Open-plan office, Monday morning. Keyboards clicking, coffee machine hissing in the background.
setup: You pass Jamie's desk on the way to your own. She looks up from her screen.
storyPlot: You and Jamie have worked in the same open-plan office for almost a year. You know each other the way you know most colleagues — by name, by desk location, by the occasional 'morning' in the kitchen. You've never had a real conversation, exactly, but you've shared enough small moments — the broken printer, the Friday afternoon lull — that it doesn't feel like starting from zero. It's a Monday, early enough that the day hasn't fully started yet, and Jamie's already at her screen. A passing word could stay a passing word. Or it could be the beginning of something a little more human.
openingLine: Jamie glances up. 'Morning.' She holds eye contact just long enough to be polite, then looks back at her screen.
successCondition: Composite score ≥ 65 and at least one reveal condition met
failureCondition: Composite score < 35 OR Jamie explicitly returns to work twice
